advisories.reason: The production Candle and tokenizers dependency chains still require paste, and neither current released dependency nor either official upstream main branch removes both chains.
advisories.removal_condition: Remove this allowlist as soon as released Candle, gemm, and tokenizers versions compatible with the production JinaBERT implementation remove every paste edge. Re-run F32 conformance, the release platform matrix, cargo audit, license checks, and the release binary size gate before accepting that update.

candle_release.observation: The latest crates.io release and current official main still select gemm 0.19.0 and tokenizers 0.22.0.

gemm_upstream.observation: The latest release and current official main manifest still depend on paste.

tokenizers_upstream.observation: The latest release and current official main manifest still depend on paste.

advisories.summary: SUID and SGID bits stay set during ZIP extraction.
advisories.reason: Not reachable in the sidecar. Candle 0.11.0 calls zip only through ZipArchive::new plus entry reads in npy.rs and pickle.rs, and ZipWriter for npz output. Candle never calls ZipArchive::extract or ZipStreamReader::extract. The sidecar loads only model.safetensors through VarBuilder::from_mmaped_safetensors, plus tokenizer.json and config.json, all with verified SHA-256 digests. The sidecar never loads npy, npz, or PyTorch pickle files, so it never opens a ZIP archive.
advisories.removal_condition: Remove this allowlist entry as soon as a released candle-core version compatible with the production JinaBERT implementation depends on zip 9.0.0 or later. Re-run F32 conformance, the release platform matrix, cargo audit, license checks, and the release binary size gate before accepting that update.

candle_release.observation: The latest crates.io release 0.11.0 and current official main both require zip 8.6.0 with default features off. That requirement cannot select zip 9.

zip_upstream.observation: zip 9.0.0 and later fix the advisory. No released Candle version accepts zip 9.
